data_usability.why: coverage_gaps: comparable expectations unavailable, and only one close so no move can be computed.

event_family.why: event.event_type is earnings; ev-1 reports EPS.

primary_context.why: No benchmark_moves in packet; a price move alone does not establish cause.

novelty.why: Packet has no previous_events, so novelty relative to prior knowledge is unresolved.

evidence_sufficiency.why: claim-1 'miss' has no consensus figure; EPS below prior period is not a negative surprise.

thesis_impact.why: Packet records no thesis claim or thesis_horizon.

research_relevance.why: Verified earnings release (ev-1) on a holding; materiality unconfirmed without expectations.

interpretation_conflict.why: Packet records no counterevidence search status, so 'no' cannot be labeled.

research_action.why: Hard gate: evidence_sufficiency insufficient forces insufficient_evidence.
